name: Osama Sharaf
description: Portfolio of Osama Sharaf, Full Stack Developer in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

projects.name: Milestone Store
projects.summary: A complete e-commerce platform for the Milestone kitchen-appliance brand: 250+ products, customer accounts, online ordering and a central admin dashboard.

projects.name: Milestone Showroom
projects.summary: A single-screen showroom website for Milestone. Every scroll swaps the scene in place, and every scene arrives with its own transition.

projects.name: Digital Codes For Trading
projects.summary: The official website of Digital Codes For Trading: a five-page company profile with custom animations, interactive UI and a 95+ PageSpeed score.

projects.name: NOUÉ Chocolate Gifts
projects.summary: A scroll-driven website for a chocolate gift house in Riyadh. One golden ribbon runs from the knot in the logo to the bow in the footer.

projects.name: OZE Chocolate
projects.summary: A one-page scroll website for OZE, a premium Swiss chocolate shop in Riyadh, in English and Arabic, with signature flavours, occasions and WhatsApp ordering.

projects.name: GHURZA Couture
projects.summary: An Arabic website for a Riyadh couture house, designed as a fashion magazine you browse by scrolling, with an interactive dress gallery.

projects.name: GD Graphic Design
projects.summary: A one-page, scroll-driven website for a graphic design studio in Riyadh. Each service has its own scene, and every scene opens with its own transition.

projects.name: AZM Studio
projects.summary: A cinematic, scroll-driven website for an architecture and interior design studio: the visitor walks from the street, through the door and into the house.

projects.name: Reem Sharaf Portfolio
projects.summary: A cinematic one-page portfolio for Eng. Reem Sharaf, software engineer, AI researcher and lecturer. Sections swap in place, each with its own transition.
